A gap is not necessarily a fault. Logs may be dropped on the live path under pressure, records marked client_visible=false never travel live at all, and a page that attached mid-run was never sent what came before it. Everything durable is on the volume regardless.

Replay by hand

Bounded to 2000 seqs per request, and defaulted small. The job's answer crosses a WebSocket with a 16 MiB frame cap — order 77,000 records — and one oversized reply closes the app's socket with a 1009, taking the job's live channel down with it. A from_seq=0 ask on a long run is that reply. There is no "resend everything" control here and there should not be one.

Feed

Click any row for the raw envelope as it arrived. Filters hide rows with CSS and drop nothing — an unticked type is still counted, still deduped, and still fills a gap.
Start a run above, or enter a run id and press Watch.
A run that has finished shows nothing here. Once the job detaches, replay answers 409 — there is no job left to ask — and GET /{run_id}/results was removed in the v4 purge, because the app holds no grant on the telemetry volume by design. Live observation is the only way to watch a run today. The volume → SQL ingestion job (Slice 4, not built) is what changes that. The telemetry itself is durable on the volume the whole time; it is this page that cannot reach it.
